create.name: Name
create.buildItLikeOneYou: Build it like one you saved
create.aServerYouSavedTo: A server you saved to build again
create.itsSettingsAreAppliedOn: Its settings are applied on top of the blueprint. The address, the players and the ports are this server's own.
create.howMuchTheServerMay: How much the server may take, as 3G or 4096M.
create.hytaleGivesOutItsServer: Hytale gives out its server files through your own account. Once this server exists, put HytaleServer.jar and Assets.zip into its Files and it starts by itself.
create.blankUsesTheNameAbove: Blank uses the name above. This is what players search for in game.
create.whatEverythingAbove32Slots: What everything above 32 slots and most roleplay resources need. Leave it on unless something asks otherwise.
create.optionalEveryPlayerNeedsThe: Optional. Every player needs the same mods to join.
create.noOtherGameServerOn: No other game server on this machine yet.
create.noDomainIsConfiguredSo: No domain is configured, so players connect to this machine's address and port. Add a domain under Settings to give servers names.
create.optionalYourDiscordUserId: Optional. Your Discord user id is the easiest to copy; a license: one comes from the game. Leave it blank and add yourself from the Players screen after you connect.
create.optionalAnIdentifierNamesNobody: Optional. An identifier names nobody at a glance.
create.onlyPlayersYouAddCan: Only players you add can join
create.everyoneElseIsTurnedAway: Everyone else is turned away at the door until you add them.
create.needsYourIdentifierAboveA: Needs your identifier above - a closed server with nobody on its list is one you cannot join either.
create.everyoneWhoJoinsTypesThis: Everyone who joins types this. Copy it before you create.
create.the17DigitNumberOn: The 17-digit number on your Steam profile.
create.optionalA17DigitNumber: Optional. A 17-digit number identifies nobody at a glance.
create.onTopOfThePassword: On top of the password. Off leaves the password as the only lock.
create.theServerStartsClosedA: The server starts closed: a password of its own, an admin password Polaris keeps for you, and nobody else let in until you add them. It is opened from the server's own Access screen.
create.itStartsWithAConsole: It starts with a console password Polaris keeps for you, player addresses hidden and ScriptHook mods refused. Who may join is changed from the server's own Security screen.
create.theServerStartsClosedNobody: The server starts closed: nobody else can join until you add them, and each player is only let in from the address registered to them. Change it later under Firewall.
create.fivemKey: FiveM will not start without one. They are free: <link>get one from keymaster</link>.
create.arkMemory: An ARK server for {count} {count, plural, one {player} other {players}} at once uses around {memory} of memory and about 30 GB of disk, downloaded the first time it starts.
create.fivemMemory: A FiveM server for {count} {count, plural, one {player} other {players}} at once uses around {memory} of memory, plus whatever the resources you install weigh.
create.otherMemory: Polaris will give it <amount></amount> of memory for {count} {count, plural, one {player} other {players}} at once. You can change it later under Settings.
create.connectToPort: Players will connect to <address></address> and its port.
create.addressHint: One address, a range like 203.0.113.0/24, or "any".
